audit.why: Hwei out-ranges Bard's poke and lockdown lands on his E; packet winRate 50.25% over 3606 games confirms an even-to-tricky lane rather than a stomp either way.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1..5].side all read 'Skill' but content win[1..5] and the packet levelChart both say 'Hwei' for the same rows — the two layers disagree on who wins levels 2 through first item.
audit.why: Hwei's Q/E combo out-ranges Bard's poke from level 2 onward and his first AP item extends that range further; the packet levelChart (Hwei x6, then Skill) and the content whys already describe this correctly. The full layer's phase chart was left stale.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[1..5].side to 'Hwei' with matching why edits so full agrees with content and the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple full-layer fields reference a fabricated ability name 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no ability by that name. His real E slot is 'Subject: Torment' (cd 12/11.5/11/10.5/10), which arms his CC forms (Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw). Also, his W 'Subject: Serenity' includes a shield form (Pool of Reflection) that is never mentioned anywhere in the current text, despite being an applicable missing interaction.
audit.why: Riot's kit text confirms the E slot name is Subject: Torment, not 'Subject: Fear'. The missing-interactions data flags that Pool of Reflection's shield absorbs burst and changes all-in math, which the page never states.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with 'Subject: Torment (E)' everywhere it appeared in full fields, added the real E cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns, and worked the W shield into breakdown.trading (tradeGood).

audit.why: Win rate 50.25% over 3606 games is already reflected accurately as a TRICKY/near-even matchup.
